text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 15 · 城市屋顶的空中花园.
Environment:  A near-future metropolitan rooftop garden at a bright hazy morning. Cream terrazzo paths wind between raised planters with soft grasses and a single small tree, curved honey-oak benches, subtle low cream safety parapets, pale gray residential towers and planted rooftops beyond. One folded newspaper with unrecognizable marks beside a ceramic travel cup on empty bench. Human-scale eye-level, inviting path center, sunlight diffused by thin cloud, tactile comfortable materials. Future conveyed by calm organization and greenery, no flying vehicles or holograms.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic overhead CONCEPT PLAN. Depict footprint, connected zones, wall thickness, doors, windows, stairs, furniture footprints and circulation. For outdoors use a site plan of paths, terrain, bridges and water instead of domestic rooms. North is only design orientation. Compact labels; no invented metric dimensions. Flat diagram on white background.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 15 · 城市屋顶的空中花园. Create ONE clear TRUE FLAT 2D floor plan or outdoor site plan reconstructing this exact reference scene, for staging and spatial understanding. Show only this location and immediate footprint, not a whole unrelated complex. Preserve distinctive architecture, openings, landmarks and furniture positions. Infer unseen bounds conservatively, mark inferred extension dashed. Black technical lines on white, pale zone fills, wall thickness, door arcs, windows, furniture horizontal footprint symbols, outdoor paths/water/terrain where relevant. North arrow is conceptual sheet orientation. No perspective, no raised walls, no fake dimension/scale numbers, no people or animals. Small English zone labels, title CONCEPT PLAN, large uncluttered plan. Good proportions and connected walkable passages. Landscape format.
